title: DeepSeek DeepInfer: a source-level systems review
lead: Released runtime, execution boundaries, and engineering implications

items: DeepInfer snapshot 9bd9cf243fc53ef9afbf8f04d391d989117d6ab9
Reviewed 23 October 2026 for AI and data infrastructure engineering leaders
Companion repositories provide context. Most slides trace inference implementation.

note: 重点读实际执行路径。代码能证明的实现、官方部署文档、工程推断分别说明。性能数据没有在本机复测。

title: The release boundary
lead: Offline inference includes model execution and local cache machinery

rows: Scheduler, model, sampler, local GPU KV/state allocation
External KV cache system and storage lifecycle
Attention DP/CP, MoE EP, expert placement and shuffle
Async worker steps, speculative decoding, output constraints
Routing and load balancing across service replicas

note: README 说缺 KV cache system，不代表没有 GPU KV 管理。必须区分本地执行内存与跨机器、可持久化的缓存服务。

title: Repository inventory by system layer
lead: The recent runtime release builds on earlier infrastructure libraries

rows: FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, DeepSelect, TileKernels, DeepJIT
DeepInfer call sites and pinned gitlinks

note: 2026 年新发布的推理组件和 2025 年开源周项目不是同一批。这里列相关系统仓库，不把所有模型权重仓库混入。

title: “Search” and “filesystem” have distinct meanings
lead: No standalone open search backend has been established in this review

rows: Local glob/grep discovery using packaged ripgrep
Agent file access, mutation containment, freshness policy
Distributed storage, separate from agent file tools
GPU TopK selection for attention and sampling

note: 用户说的 search 仍可能指其他项目。已验证的 web search 是 API 客户端，不是爬虫或索引后端。文件系统工具与 3FS 也不能混为一谈。

title: The public entry point
lead: LLM.generate adds every request before driving the engine loop

items: _add_request copies sampling parameters, tokenizes if needed, converts IDs to int32.
The offline example configures EP/DP/CP, memory fraction, token budget and sequence cap.

note: 这不是 HTTP server。批量输入由 Python API 注入 engine，适合离线推理与集成验证。

title: Request and token execution flow
lead: One request moves through admission, metadata, forward, sampling, and reclamation

rows: State update and next token output

note: 按调用链读代码比按目录猜架构更可靠。step 返回的结果在异步路径可能属于上一个 batch。

title: Batch type requires group agreement
lead: NORMAL engines vote on prefill versus decode across DP ranks

items: The watermark is 0.9. Configured intervals create ALL and ANY attempt points.
Idle ranks execute a placeholder prefill step when another rank has work.
A second vote falls back to decode when admission fails everywhere.

note: 这保证 collective 的执行步型一致。ANY 尝试给孤立 rank 兜底，第二次投票避免 waiting 有请求却无法分配时反复空跑。

title: Prefill admission and chunking
lead: The queue head must satisfy memory, sequence, and token constraints

items: _schedule_prefill scans waiting requests from the front and stops at an unschedulable head.
AllocStatus::LATER waits for blocks. NEVER rejects a request that exceeds total capacity.
The remaining batch-token budget bounds each chunk, aligned to CP requirements.
The scheduler also limits prompt count and aggregate key length. Forked prefixes require block/state cloning.

note: 公开版本这段 admission 主要受 token、slot、KV 限制。部署 Q&A 描述的跨实例 compute-quota 路由不能当作这里已经完整实现。

title: Decode admission and preemption
lead: Memory pressure can terminate requests or send them back for recomputation

items: The scheduler admits prompted requests and prepares forked state and tail blocks.
It sorts running sequences by output length, visits the short-output end, and preempts from the opposite end when blocks run out.
_append_slot grows each admitted sequence, then MTPVarlen.schedule chooses verification lengths.
_preempt stops structured-output requests and stop-on-preemption configurations. Other requests reset and re-enter waiting.

note: 这里的排序键是已生成长度，不是预测完成时间。COMPLETION 引擎没有 prefill 通道，构造时强制 stop_preempted_request=true。

title: Asynchronous scheduling overlaps retirement
lead: The worker launches current forward before retiring previous sampling results

blocks.text:
# Worker.execute_model_step, order abridged
main_model_output = self.model_runner.execute_main_model(...)
request_outputs = self._post_process_step(self.prev_step_state)
sampler_output = self.model_runner.execute_sample(...)
# ZOS decode defers current post-process to the next step
self.prev_step_state = curr_step_state

items: Prompt and non-ZOS steps retire immediately. ZOS decode keeps one previous step in flight.
execute_main_model and execute_sample wrap their device launch sections in forbid_cuda_sync().

note: “zero overhead”是优化目标，不是没有 CPU 工作。关键是 CPU bookkeeping 与下一次 GPU forward 重叠，而不是神奇地消失。

title: Scheduling ahead requires device corrections
lead: CPU sequence lengths can lag the most recent sampling decision

items: prepare_zos_inputs maps overlapping sequences between the current and previous batch.
GPU kernels use prior acceptance counts to correct key lengths and confidence rates to adjust query lengths.
Varlen query lengths copy back asynchronously. The worker waits for that copy before updating CPU sampling metadata.
The final drain explicitly synchronizes and processes remaining in-flight work.

note: 异步优化把依赖转成显式 remap 和事件。集成时不能绕开 flush，也不能把 CPU cache.num_tokens 当作最新 GPU 状态。

title: Object lifetime is part of correctness
lead: Pooled outputs and borrowed vectors need explicit ownership rules

items: LLMEngine.step documents that RequestOutput objects expire on the next step.
The offline loop clones each output before retaining it.
Scheduler outputs borrow clone/zero vector storage that the next schedule() clears.
Deferred release collects metadata, outputs, and block/state unpins across worker execution.

note: 对外做 streaming wrapper 时尤其容易踩这个坑：必须复制或明确转移生命周期，不能把池化指针异步留给网络线程。

title: Local block allocation and sharing
lead: BlockManager tracks free blocks and reference counts under a lock

items: Block ID 0 is reserved as an empty sentinel.
Sequence block tables reference physical storage. Fork paths pin shared data and clone writable tail blocks.
A separate state manager reserves recurrent/compression state slots alongside KV blocks.

note: 公开代码能读到显存内 block 分配和共享语义，但这不等于前缀 hash 索引、跨实例恢复、存储 GC 都已开源。

title: KV memory includes multiple representations
lead: Cache sizing follows attention layout, indexer precision, and rollback history

rows: V41_FORMAT / V41_FP4_FORMAT include data and scale bytes
FP4 channels plus one UE8M0 scale per 32 channels
layer_kv_map and index maps reuse earlier layer storage

note: 不能直接套传统 MHA 的 layers×heads×head_dim 公式。这里有压缩、量化、状态环和跨层共享，容量规划必须按实际模型配置计算。

title: Bounded replay compacts consumer work
lead: YoCo keeps a bounded suffix where the model structure permits it

items: The model configuration divides producer and consumer layers at n_prefill_layer.
yoco_boundary_compact gathers kept query rows. With CP, it gathers contributions and redistributes compact rows.
Consumer metadata switches query-aligned fields and the SWA visibility domain.
README defaults use compact mode and 140 retained tokens. The suffix must cover SWA plus maximum backtracking.

note: 这不是任意模型都能截断 prefix。依赖 YoCo 层结构和恢复状态，140 是该版本 V4.1 配置，不是通用窗口。

title: Attention and experts use different groups
lead: DP, CP, and EP compose around the model execution path

rows: Separate request streams, synchronized batch-type decisions
Distributes context work, uses gather and broadcast helpers
Contiguous expert groups exchange routed token activations
Gloo groups coordinate host-side metadata and decisions
CP metadata broadcast when CP size exceeds one

note: 源码支持 CP，部署 Q&A 同时说当前生产配置未使用 TP/CP。支持能力与具体线上配置需要分开看。

title: MoE dispatch, expert compute, and combine
lead: The forward path explicitly coordinates communication and shared experts

blocks.text:
topk_idx, topk_weights = self.gate_forward(...)
event_overlap = self.dispatch(...)
moe_in_hidden, ..., handle = event_overlap.current_stream_wait()
moe_out_hidden = self.routed_experts_forward(...)
combine_pre_evt = self.ep_buffer.capture()
shared_out = self.shared_forward(hidden_states)
event_overlap = self.combine(..., shared_out, handle, combine_pre_evt)

items: DeepEP owns token exchange and handles. Routed expert weights use rank-local physical expert rows.
The standard path limits communication SM use while computing shared experts. A separate mega-MoE branch exists.

note: 通信开销与计算并行设计绑定。单看 GEMM 吞吐不能推导整个 MoE step 的收益。

title: EPLB balances physical expert replicas
lead: The policy uses historical per-step load rather than only total token counts

items: rebalance_experts_global allocates redundant replicas to hot logical experts.
_batch_greedy_indices places physical experts under per-rank capacity constraints.
The placement objective sums the per-step maximum rank load over the history window.
Shuffle code offers batched P2P and an intranode symmetric-memory/IPC path. This differs from request routing across replicas.

note: EPLB 改 expert 布局，DP load balancer 改请求去向。两者优化不同失衡来源，不能因为有 EPLB 就宣称公开了完整服务路由。

title: Attention combines SWA and compressed KV
lead: Prefill and decode use different data paths into sparse attention kernels

rows: Builds full/SWA and compressed indices, calls prefill_attn_varlen_sparse
Reads paged swa_cache and ca_cache, calls decode_mla_mqa_sparse
Fused norm/RoPE/cast plus DeepGEMM output projection
Kernel scheduling metadata and index lengths vary by attention configuration

note: 这里描述的是 V4 模块实现，不把 V3 的 MLA 简图直接套过来。SWA、压缩索引和共享层会改变数据可见范围。

title: Indexer logits feed TopK attention selection
lead: DeepSelect selects token indices inside the model

blocks.text:
# MQA._topk_prefill, abridged
p_sum = self._compute_prefill_p_sum(...)
topk(p_sum, self.topk_tokens, sorted=False,
     end=topk_lens[chunk], sorted_index=True,
     output_idx=topk_index[chunk],
     idx_oob_fill_value=-1, return_value=False)

items: DeepGEMM computes dense or sparse FP8/FP4 MQA logits.
Prefill chunks the query computation to bound temporary score storage. Decode uses paged metadata.
Candidate-block paths restore token indices after TopK selection.

note: 模型内部的检索/TopK 与 web search 是不同概念。这里返回注意力 token 索引，不是文档搜索结果。

title: Kernel dependencies are pinned separately
lead: DeepInfer records exact vendor gitlinks rather than bundling all implementation
note: 本次深读重点是 runtime 与库的接口，不声称逐行审计所有 vendor kernel。复现时必须递归获取这些锁定版本。

title: Graph buckets influence execution cost
lead: The graph runner selects the smallest captured bucket that covers total_q

blocks.text:
index = bisect_left(self.batch_sizes, total_q)
if index == len(self.batch_sizes):
    raise ValueError(...)
batch_size = self.batch_sizes[index]
return batch_size, self.graphs[batch_size]

items: Capture stores reusable graph outputs and input buffers, sharing a memory pool.
The replay path uses a graph handle for timing when supported.
Bucket padding affects both execution cost and the speculative scheduler’s best batch choice.

note: 有效 token 数与 graph bucket 大小是两个量。调参要同时看 padding、内存与测得的耗时曲线，不能只增加 batch 上限。

title: Confidence scheduling chooses verification work
lead: MTPVarlen maximizes expected accepted tokens per estimated step time

items: One golden token per sequence forms the baseline. Ranked confidence estimates add draft verification slots.
N−2 confidence chooses total work. N−1 information allocates per-sequence lengths, with GPU correction under ZOS.
Measured forward/sampler times update runtime estimates. No decode curve falls back to all available drafts.

note: DSpark 的关键是 draft 和 verification 的联合系统设计。这里不是固定每个请求验证 5 个 token，nextn 只是最大草稿长度。

title: A device kernel redistributes the token budget
lead: The CUDA TileLang implementation ranks cumulative draft confidence

blocks.text:
# Example, two sequences and two draft positions
conditional rates:  A [0.9, 0.8]   B [0.6, 0.9]
cumulative rates:   A [0.9, 0.72]  B [0.6, 0.54]
total_q = 5, golden tokens = 2, extra budget = 3
selected drafts: A1, A2, B1
seqlens_q: A = 3, B = 2

items: Phase 1 gathers prior rows through remap and computes cumulative products. Fresh rows use zero rates.
Phase 2 counts better candidates in parallel. Higher confidence wins, with lower flat index breaking ties.
Each sequence gets one golden token plus its selected drafts. This is an explicit rank-counting kernel, not a full sort.

note: 示例按代码手算，未运行 GPU。pairwise rank counting 的工作量随 batch 和 nextn 增长，适合结合实际小 nextn 和测量结果评估，不能凭算法名假设无限扩展。

title: Output constraints interact with recovery
lead: Determinism and structured decoding require explicit configurations

rows: README requires batch invariance, MTP varlen off, and fixed seq_seed on NVIDIA
JSON schema, regex, or EBNF compile through XGrammar
Matcher builds next-token vocabulary masks and supports rollback
Structured-output state currently blocks recomputation and causes request termination

note: “支持 JSON schema”不代表任何资源压力下都可透明重试。服务层要把 FINISHED_PREEMPTED 等结束原因准确传给上层。

title: Recipe supplies a protocol boundary
lead: deepseek-recipe converts conversations and output streams around an inference backend

items: Rust libraries and Python bindings handle API conversion, prompt rendering, token encoding, and response parsing.
PromptTokenizer.encode_ids receives explicit special-token ranges rather than treating all matching text as control tokens.
The caller supplies inference, tool execution, and HTTP transport. Constraint declarations still require backend enforcement.

note: 要做兼容 API，tokenizer.encode(prompt) 之外还有协议语义。Recipe 是可复用边界，但不会自动把 DeepInfer 变成完整在线服务。

title: Benchmark scope and reproducibility
lead: The published Pareto curves use different prefill and decode deployments

headers: What an engineering comparison must retain
rows: Input length, cached prefix, batch size, YoCo clipping
Context length, request concurrency, nextn and acceptance assumptions
Topology and communication differ from cross-domain deployment
Sweeps batch sizes with profiling disabled and emits JSONL

note: 本 deck 不转抄图中曲线点，也不把离线结果当作线上 SLA。官方部署文档的集群规模、收入和约 80% 离线效率是陈述，不是本次验证结果。

title: Deployment prerequisites and missing services
lead: The released target is Linux with recent datacenter accelerators

items: Supported model: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Hardware: NVIDIA SM100 or Huawei Ascend 950.
README requires GCC ≥13, Python 3.12, CUDA 13 or CANN 9.2. A Mac cannot validate device execution.
A full service still needs request routing, cache lookup/storage lifecycle, inter-stage transfer, cancellation, and API transport.
Published Q&A describes external KV storage on 3FS and DP balancing. Those descriptions do not establish complete released source.

note: 平台适配不等于任意显卡兼容。上线评估应先建立硬件、模型、锁定依赖和失败恢复矩阵，再考虑吞吐优化。

title: Engineering takeaways
lead: The strongest reusable ideas lie at state and execution boundaries

rows: Test abort, batch membership change, final drain, and rollback together
Measure hot-expert skew and redistribution cost at intended EP size
Budget HBM from actual formats and backtracking requirements
Profile graph buckets and sampler cost under realistic concurrency
Estimate external cache and routing integration before committing to adoption

note: 这些是基于代码的工程建议，不是作者承诺。可先复用思想、验证局部组件，再决定是否整体采用 runtime。

lead: Every technical slide links a reviewed snapshot and source location

items: Read next: entrypoints/llm.py, engine/llm_engine.py, csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp, worker/worker.py.
Model path: v4_modules/attn.py, index_attn.py, mlp.py, plus worker/cache_engine.py.
Companions: harness search/file seams and Recipe token encoding. Full source index includes per-slide links.
